outcomes.description: This Micro-B to USB 3.0 Type-A external hard drive cable is designed to connect USB 3.0 portable hard drives and storage devices to computers and laptops with standard USB-A ports. It provides a reliable and efficient solution for accessing, transferring, and backing up data from external drives used in home, office, and professional environments. Supporting USB 3.0 SuperSpeed data transfer rates of up to 5Gbps, this cable allows fast file transfers while remaining backwards compatible with USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 systems. The Micro-B USB 3.0 connector includes additional pins required for high-speed performance, making it suitable for modern external hard drives and storage enclosures. Built for durability and consistent signal performance, this cable ensures stable connectivity during everyday use. It is ideal for connecting portable external hard drives used for media storage, backups, and large data transfers without signal loss or interruptions. Available in multiple cable lengths, this Micro-B to USB-A cable offers flexibility for both compact desktop setups and longer reach requirements, making it a dependable choice for USB 3.0 external storage connectivity.
outcomes.label_line: Micro-B to USB 3.0 Type-A External Hard Drive Cable – SuperSpeed 5Gbps (part RO9-2430)
